name: Surge XT
notes: Upstream is a large JUCE synth. It needs a dedicated DSP-only setup before wadspa can expose it as a browser instrument.

name: Vitalium
notes: Tracked through DISTRHO-Ports. It needs dedicated preset/wavetable asset handling and a DSP-only LV2 setup.

name: Odin 2
notes: Upstream supports LV2, but the JUCE/CMake build must be reduced to the DSP and metadata path for WASM.

name: Helm
notes: Upstream is a full synth with visual modulation UI. It needs a dedicated setup script before it can be tested in the browser catalog.

name: Cardinal
notes: Cardinal is a modular host-style instrument with many bundled modules. It needs a custom reduced WASM build plan.

name: Dexed
notes: Tracked as an exact DX7 target. Existing mda_DX10 covers simple FM, but does not count as Dexed support.

name: ADLplug
notes: Tracked as an exact OPL/OPN chip target. It needs a dedicated setup for its recursive dependencies and LV2 metadata.

name: JuceOPL
notes: Tracked through DISTRHO-Ports. It needs an extracted LV2 build target before it can be packaged.

name: VL1-Emulator
notes: Tracked as an exact Casio VL-Tone target. It needs confirmation of LV2 metadata and a DSP-only build.

name: ZynAddSubFX
notes: Source is already tracked locally. The full synth has a large engine/DPF path and still needs a dedicated setup script.

name: amsynth
notes: Exact target is built as a MIDI instrument and covered by the LV2 smoke and slider tests.

name: Obxd
notes: Tracked through DISTRHO-Ports. It is not equivalent to the current mda_JX10 virtual analog instrument.

name: synthv1
notes: Exact target is built as a MIDI instrument and covered by the LV2 smoke and slider tests.

name: Calf Monosynth
notes: Tracked through the Calf Studio Gear LV2 suite. It needs extraction from the suite before it can be packaged.

name: DISTRHO Nekobi
notes: Tracked as the exact Nekobi acid synth. Existing so-404 is also TB-303-style but does not count as Nekobi support.

name: Geonkick
notes: Exact target is built as a MIDI-triggered kick drum instrument and covered by the LV2 smoke and slider tests.

name: Chow Kick
notes: Tracked as an exact physically modeled kick target. It needs a JUCE/CMake-to-wadspa setup script.

name: setBfree
notes: Only setBfree reverb and overdrive effects are packaged today. The B3 organ instrument still needs its own setup.

name: padthv1
notes: Exact target is built as a MIDI instrument and covered by the LV2 smoke and slider tests.

name: Infamous Cellular Automaton Synth
notes: Tracked through Infamous Plugins. It needs a dedicated LV2 setup and control mapping before browser packaging.
